intro: Oakville's downtown is walkable and leans upscale-casual. A short list for now — we're still adding to it.

picks.name: Piano Piano
picks.why: Bright, cheerful Italian with pizzas and pastas designed for sharing.

picks.name: Colossus Greek Taverna
picks.why: Classic Greek taverna fare — souvlaki, saganaki and big salads.

picks.name: Punjabi By Nature
picks.why: North Indian curries and tandoori dishes for when you're craving something rich and spicy.

picks.name: Kibo Sushi
picks.why: Reliable sushi and Japanese plates — an easy choice when nobody can agree.
